Guest Stars: Rooms.desc: Added A-60, A-200, Bleach and No Good to the roster, A-60 and Bleach is like Angler, A-200 locks on you and goes through wall, No Good is behind unopened door and must wait for him gone first before opening.

Weeper.desc: Break line of sight from Eden Trees. Look away, down and crouch is recommended.

Its you! its me!.desc: Coagulate spawns more often, if caught, you're controlled by it temporarily.

Gone Fishin.desc: Added Bobber Fish, stand still when eye opened, can keep moving when not yet opened.

Kitty Clock.desc: Gives you Kitty Clock, twist to set back timer but too far will break it. Must use it when alarm plays.

Cereal.desc: Skinless spawns more often, try to look away from him as he'll force you to look at him.

Always Eyefestation.desc: Any chances where Eyefestation can spawn, it will spawn.

Enraged Eyefestation.desc: Eyefestation will always spawn when it could and will be enraged by default.

NAVIgation Malfunction.desc: NAVI doesn't keep count of door for you anymore, except Heavy Containment.

Budget Cutbacks.desc: Tools last half as long, don't use it when unnecessary.

Night Light: Off.desc: No visual indicator for mines, watch your step.

Art Portfolio.desc: P.AI.nter shows you art, you can close his pop ups.

DOORS STUCK.desc: Some door may stay stuck, you might need to kick it.

Glue.desc: Some drawer will require more press to open.

Wet Floor? All Clean!.desc: Puddle of Void Mass puddles are gone, though visual indicator/glowing eyes in the locker will still show.

Butterfingers.desc: Your item can slip off your hand, only hold when necessary.

Squid+.desc: Don't stay too close to squiddles, it will attack way faster than normal and leaves temporary ink cover.

Sitcom.desc: Laughing SFX plays when you take damage, so avoid that.

Freeze Frame.desc: Frame frozen when you take any damage, may cause some issue to sensitive people.

Restless Dreams.desc: Added thick black fog to your entire run, cannot be removed.
